t: The Magnusson 9tpi Hardwood Panel Saw is a robust manual tool designed for efficient coarse cutting of hardwood materials. The 5-piece value pack is ideal for busy carpenters and joiners needing reliable tools across multiple job sites or for workshop stock. Each saw is fitted with a 20" (500mm) blade made from 0.9mm heat-treated carbon steel, ensuring durability, longevity, and consistent performance. Triple-ground teeth provide a smooth and fast coarse cut through tough hardwood. Ergonomic ABS plastic handle offers comfortable and secure grip during prolonged use.
b: 3-Face Ground, Heat-Treated Teeth for Smooth Cutting
